features.title: Fixed-step deterministic sim core
acceptance: The sim state is one plain JSON-serializable object advanced by step(state, world, input) at a fixed 60 Hz
A seeded RNG (mulberry32) lives in the state; src/sim and src/world never call Math.random or Date
The same seed and inputs give an identical state hash after 600 ticks; a sim test proves it
src/sim imports nothing from the DOM, WebGL or three.js renderer code and runs in Node
features.evidence: tests/sim/core.test.ts (determinism hash, JSON round trip, rng, no nondeterministic APIs); commit feat(M1-01)

features.title: Box and ramp collision world
acceptance: Solids are axis-aligned boxes or ramps (a box whose top slopes along one axis) indexed in a 4 m uniform grid
Queries: box overlap, ground height under a point, and a raycast returning distance and normal of the first hit
Unit tests cover box overlap, ramp surface height, ray hits on boxes and ramps, and misses
features.evidence: tests/sim/geom.test.ts (overlap, ramp height, groundAt, raycast boxes/ramps/misses); commit feat(M1-02)

features.title: AABB carving
acceptance: carve(solids, box) replaces every overlapped solid with up to 6 boxes covering its remainder
Unit tests: a tunnel carved through a block leaves walls, floor and ceiling around an empty interior, and volume is conserved minus the carved part
features.evidence: tests/sim/geom.test.ts carving suite (tunnel, room, volume); commit feat(M1-03)

features.title: Player kinematics: jog, sprint, crouch, gravity, stairs
acceptance: Jog 3.2, sprint 7.0 and crouch 1.6 m/s on flat ground within 3% once accelerated
Walls stop the player with no tunnelling at sprint speed or in a 30 m/s fall
Steps up to 0.45 m are climbed automatically; a 30-degree stair ramp is climbed at jog speed and descended without leaving the ground
Crouching under a 1.3 m ceiling works and standing up there is refused
features.evidence: tests/sim/kinematics.test.ts (speeds, walls, 30 m/s landing, step-up 0.45, 30-degree stairs both ways, crouch ceiling); commit feat(M1-04)

features.title: Jump
acceptance: Standing jump apex is between 0.6 and 0.7 m (U-004: more vertical)
A running jump at sprint clears a 4.5 m gap and lands on the far side; a 5.2 m gap is not cleared to a standing landing
Air acceleration is limited to 4 m/s^2
features.evidence: tests/sim/jump.test.ts (apex 0.6-0.7, 4.5 clears, 5.2 fails, air control, no air speed-up); commit feat(M1-05)

features.title: Space hops and the hand mantle
acceptance: Space onto a ledge 0.5-1.2 m above the feet hops up (about 0.35 s); higher ledges are refused for Space (U-002)
Gripping a ledge lip and pulling up (W or Space) with the body high enough mantles onto the top when there is room for a crouched body
A standing grab reaches ledge lips up to 2.3 m and a jump up to 2.8 m, so 2.4 m ledges are climbable and a 3.0 m lip needs a run-up
Sim tests cover hops, refusals and hand mantles
features.evidence: tests/sim/mantle.test.ts Space hops; tests/sim/grip.test.ts hand mantle (1.0-2.2 standing, 2.4 with jump, 3.0 refused); commit feat(M1-06)

features.title: Vault
acceptance: At 2.5 m/s or more, jump at an obstacle 0.5-1.2 m high and at most 1.2 m deep vaults over it in about 0.45 s keeping at least 80% of speed
A deeper obstacle, or one without landing space, is mantled onto instead
A sim test covers the vault and the mantle-instead case
features.evidence: tests/sim/mantle.test.ts vault suite (vault keeps >80% speed, deep and blocked fall back to mantle); commit feat(M1-07)

features.title: Crouch and crawl
acceptance: Crawling (0.5 m tall) passes a 0.6 m gap that crouching (1.1 m) cannot
Getting up from a crawl or crouch is refused under a low ceiling
A sim test drives the player through a 0.6 m crawl gap
features.evidence: tests/sim/crawl.test.ts crouch and crawl suite; commit feat(M1-08)

features.title: Slide
acceptance: Crouch while sprinting at 6 m/s or more starts a 1.0 s slide decelerating from about 7.5 to 3 m/s
The slide passes under a bar with 0.6 m clearance and ends crouched
A sim test covers it
features.evidence: tests/sim/crawl.test.ts slide suite; commit feat(M1-09)

features.title: Hanging and hand-over-hand traverse
acceptance: Gripping hangs him below the grip with gravity off; S lets the arms extend, W pulls up, releasing every hand drops him
Grabbing a point further along the ledge and releasing the other hand moves him along it (hand over hand)
Falling past a ledge while holding a mouse button looking at its lip catches it (a jump falling short of a 5.2 m gap can be saved)
Sim tests cover hanging, traversing and the mid-air catch
features.evidence: tests/sim/grip.test.ts hanging suite (hang/pull/drop, hand over hand, mid-air catch over a 5.2 m gap); commit feat(M1-10)

features.title: Wall-run on a second Space
acceptance: In the air within 0.8 m of a wall, moving 4 m/s or more and looking along the wall, Space starts a wall-run of up to 3 steps (about 0.9 s) in the look direction (U-004)
A wall-run crosses a 6 m gap along a wall that a plain running jump cannot
Space during a wall-run kicks off the wall in the camera direction
Space on the ground never starts a wall-run
Sim tests cover it
features.evidence: tests/sim/wall.test.ts (second-Space wall-run over 6 m gap, kick off by camera, no wall-run from ground Space); commit feat(M1-11); dropped by U-007, restored by U-008

features.title: Run-up kick and dyno
acceptance: Jump at a wall, then Space again looking up at it, kicks him up the wall (no automatic grab); grabbing at the top of the kick reaches lips up to about 3.8 m (U-004)
Space while gripping launches a dyno upward that must be caught by another grab
Sim tests cover a 3.5 m wall by jump, up-kick and grab, and a 4.5 m wall refused
features.evidence: tests/sim/grip.test.ts run-up suite (jump + up-kick + grab 3.5 m, 4.5 m refused, kick never grabs, dyno to a lip 2 m up); commit feat(M1-12)

features.title: Pipes and ladders by hand
acceptance: Drain pipes and ladder rungs are grabbable anywhere along their length; climbing them is alternate grabs
Ladders climb faster (less grip drain) than pipes
A sim test climbs a 6 m pipe and a 4 m ladder by hand and steps off at the top
features.evidence: tests/sim/pipes.test.ts (6 m pipe and 4 m ladder by hand, ladder drains less); commit feat(M1-13)

features.title: Fall outcomes and landing roll
acceptance: Falls up to 4 m have no consequence; longer falls emit damage and injury events per DESIGN section 3; over 12 m is lethal
Holding crouch within 0.3 s before landing rolls, so a 6.5 m drop has no consequence
Sim tests for 3.5 m, 6.5 m with and without a roll, 9 m and 13 m
features.evidence: tests/sim/falls.test.ts (3.5, 6.5 with/without roll, 9, 13 m, table edges); commit feat(M1-14)

features.title: Hide in a box
acceptance: E at a hiding box with an interior of 0.8 m or more curls him in (0.75 m, posture hidden) in 0.6 s; E again exits in 0.5 s
Movement is blocked while hidden and the eye sits inside the box
A sim test enters and exits a 0.8 m box and is refused by a 0.6 m one
features.evidence: tests/sim/hide.test.ts (0.8 m box in/out timings, blocked movement, 0.6 m refused); commit feat(M1-15)

features.title: Grip endurance (no running stamina)
acceptance: Running, jumping, vaults and wall-runs cost nothing (U-003); low energy and injuries are what slow him
Grip endurance drains while hanging (one hand faster than two, ladders slower) and refills when the hands are free; at zero the grip slips
Sim tests cover unlimited sprinting and grip slip and recovery
features.evidence: tests/sim/pipes.test.ts endurance suite (30 s sprint unslowed, one-hand slip ~16 s, two hands ~3x, refill); commit feat(M1-16)

features.title: Swimming and diving
acceptance: Water volumes: surface swim 1.4 m/s (2.2 sprinting), C dives, breath lasts 40 s, then drowning damage events
He can climb out onto a bank up to 0.6 m above the surface
He stays wet for 120 game minutes after leaving the water
A sim test covers swimming, diving and climbing out
features.evidence: tests/sim/swim.test.ts (swim speeds, float, dive, breath 40 s, climb out 0.5 m bank, wet); commit feat(M1-17)

features.title: Movement noise events
acceptance: Footsteps emit noise events with radii crawl 1, crouch 2, jog 8, sprint 16 m; landings from over 2 m emit 15 m; vaults 6 m
Rain halves footstep radii
A unit test checks the emitted events
features.evidence: tests/sim/noise.test.ts (gait radii, stride cadence, rain halving, landing 15, vault 6); commit feat(M1-18)

features.title: Movement tuning in data

A test runs the sim with a modified tuning copy and sees the change (sprint speed)

features.title: Hand grab core (White Knuckle style)

With any grip the body hangs and reels toward the grip with collision; two hands drain grip stamina slower than one; at 0 stamina the hands slip
Grabbing keeps momentum: one hand holds his weight when he is slow but, moving fast, slips after redirecting him; two hands can stop a sprint or a short fall (U-004)
Smooth walls, glass and open air are not grabbable
While he holds an item the hands cannot grab (U-007); with nothing grabbable in reach left mouse uses the item
Sim tests cover grip, release, reel, stamina slip and refusals
features.evidence: tests/sim/grip.test.ts (grip, release, reel, endurance slip, refusals incl. no grab while holding an item, U-007); commit feat(M1-26)

features.title: Push-off from a hang

Letting go mid-swing keeps the swing velocity: a lache across a 4 m gap between bars works

features.title: Wall cling window

During the cling he can kick, wall-run, up-kick or grab; after it he slides down
A palm-on-the-wall hand sprite and a soft pat sound mark the cling
